'''Hangar RS-32''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in [[Pallista Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the criminal [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] docked there.<ref name="SWTOR" />
